column1: # Claude Code setup, one line per item: kind, name, source, profiles.
# Local plugins live in claude/mods; the module links ~/.claude/mods to it.
#   mcp-http     <name>  <URL>[ <extra claude mcp add flags>]  (run /mcp once to log in)
# profiles: "brain" (laptop and your server account), "laptop" or "server"
# (one of them only), "agent" (<you>-agent: work tools only, nothing that
# reaches your personal data or posts as you).
# No keys in this file; they are typed on each machine.
